```{r}
# ==========================================
# UNIVERSAL TUBERCULOSIS FUNDING SHOCK PIPELINE
# INTEGRATING: SKS7267 & LIU-YUETING DESIGN LOGIC
# ==========================================

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. INITIALIZATION & DEPENDENCIES
# ------------------------------------------
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "caret", "xgboost", "randomForest", 
                       "missForest", "robustbase", "smotefamily", "pROC")
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

library(tidyverse)    
library(caret)        
library(xgboost)      
library(randomForest) 
library(missForest)   
library(robustbase)   
library(smotefamily)   
library(pROC)         

set.seed(42)

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. DATA CONFIGURATION & SIMULATION ENGINE
# ------------------------------------------
generate_mock_integrated_data <- function(n_samples = 2000) {
  countries <- paste0("Country_", 1:79) 
  years <- 2020:2025
  
  data_records <- tibble(
    country = sample(countries, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    year = sample(years, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    annual_income = rexp(n_samples, rate = 1/5000) + 500,
    tb_cost = rexp(n_samples, rate = 1/1200) + 100,
    
    patient_age = sample(15:75, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    patient_sex = sample(c(0, 1), n_samples, replace = TRUE), 
    drug_resistance_type = sample(c(0, 1, 2), n_samples, replace = TRUE), 
    gdp_per_capita = runif(n_samples, 800, 12000),             
    health_spending_per_capita = runif(n_samples, 50, 1500),   
    
    air_pollution_pm25 = runif(n_samples, 10, 90),
    mdr_tb_incidence = runif(n_samples, 0.5, 15),
    hiv_positive_tb_incidence = runif(n_samples, 1, 40),
    life_expectancy = runif(n_samples, 50, 82),
    cigarette_retail_price = runif(n_samples, 1.5, 12),
    adult_hypertension_prevalence = runif(n_samples, 15, 45),
    electricity_access_pct = runif(n_samples, 20, 100)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_catastrophic_cost = ifelse((tb_cost / annual_income) > 0.20, 1, 0)
  )
  
  missing_cols <- c("air_pollution_pm25", "health_spending_per_capita", "electricity_access_pct")
  for(col in missing_cols) {
    data_records[sample(1:n_samples, n_samples * 0.05), col] <- NA
  }
  
  return(data_records)
}

df_raw <- generate_mock_integrated_data()

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. PREPROCESSING AND ANALYSIS MATRIX
# ------------------------------------------
feature_cols <- c(
  "patient_age", "patient_sex", "drug_resistance_type", "gdp_per_capita",
  "health_spending_per_capita", "air_pollution_pm25", "mdr_tb_incidence",
  "hiv_positive_tb_incidence", "life_expectancy", "cigarette_retail_price",
  "adult_hypertension_prevalence", "electricity_access_pct"
)
target_col <- "is_catastrophic_cost"

df_imputed <- df_raw %>% select(all_of(c(feature_cols, target_col))) %>% as.data.frame()
imputation_results <- missForest(df_imputed, maxiter = 5, ntree = 50)
df_processed <- imputation_results$ximp

skewed_cols <- c("gdp_per_capita", "health_spending_per_capita", "mdr_tb_incidence", "hiv_positive_tb_incidence")
for (col in skewed_cols) {
  df_processed[[col]] <- log1p(df_processed[[col]])
}

pca_obj <- prcomp(df_processed[, feature_cols], scale. = TRUE)
pca_scores <- pca_obj$x[, 1:3] 
mcd_robust <- covMcd(pca_scores)
mahal_dist <- mahalanobis(pca_scores, center = mcd_robust$center, cov = mcd_robust$cov)

threshold <- quantile(mahal_dist, 0.95)
df_filtered <- df_processed[mahal_dist <= threshold, ]

scaler_pipeline <- preProcess(df_filtered[, feature_cols], method = c("center", "scale"))
X_scaled <- predict(scaler_pipeline, df_filtered[, feature_cols])
y <- df_filtered[[target_col]]

smote_output <- SMOTE(X_scaled, y, K = 5, dup_size = 2)
df_resampled <- smote_output$data

X_matrix <- as.matrix(df_resampled[, feature_cols])
y_vector <- as.numeric(df_resampled$class == "1")

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. K-FOLD EVALUATION LOOPS
# ------------------------------------------
folds <- createFolds(as.factor(y_vector), k = 10, returnTrain = TRUE)

rf_auc <- c(); xgb_auc <- c(); base_auc <- c()
rf_f1  <- c(); xgb_f1  <- c(); base_f1  <- c()

for(i in 1:length(folds)) {
  train_idx <- folds[[i]]
  
  X_train <- X_matrix[train_idx, ]; y_train <- y_vector[train_idx] 
  X_val   <- X_matrix[-train_idx, ]; y_val   <- y_vector[-train_idx] 
  
  X_train_b <- as.matrix(X_train[, "gdp_per_capita", drop = FALSE])
  X_val_b   <- as.matrix(X_val[, "gdp_per_capita", drop = FALSE])
  
  rf_model   <- randomForest(x = X_train, y = as.factor(y_train), ntree = 100)
  base_model <- randomForest(x = X_train_b, y = as.factor(y_train), ntree = 100)
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)
  xgb_model <- xgb.train(params = list(objective = "binary:logistic"), 
                         data = dtrain, 
                         nrounds = 50, 
                         verbose = 0)
  
  rf_prob   <- predict(rf_model, X_val, type = "prob")[, 2]
  base_prob <- predict(base_model, X_val, type = "prob")[, 2]
  xgb_prob  <- predict(xgb_model, X_val)
  
  rf_auc[i]   <- auc(roc(y_val, rf_prob, quiet=TRUE))
  xgb_auc[i]  <- auc(roc(y_val, xgb_prob, quiet=TRUE))
  base_auc[i] <- auc(roc(y_val, base_prob, quiet=TRUE))
  
  rf_f1[i]    <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(ifelse(rf_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)), as.factor(y_val))$byClass["F1"]
  xgb_f1[i]   <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(ifelse(xgb_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)), as.factor(y_val))$byClass["F1"]
  base_f1[i]  <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(ifelse(base_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)), as.factor(y_val))$byClass["F1"]
}

cat("\n--- 10-Fold Cross-Validation Performance Output Summary ---\n")
cat(sprintf("Income Baseline Model -> Mean F1: %.3f | Mean AUC: %.3f\n", mean(base_f1, na.rm=TRUE), mean(base_auc)))
cat(sprintf("Random Forest Model   -> Mean F1: %.3f | Mean AUC: %.3f\n", mean(rf_f1, na.rm=TRUE), mean(rf_auc)))
cat(sprintf("XGBoost Classifier    -> Mean F1: %.3f | Mean AUC: %.3f\n\n", mean(xgb_f1, na.rm=TRUE), mean(xgb_auc)))

# ------------------------------------------
# 5. INTEGRATED FEATURE IMPORTANCE (NATIVE ENGINE)
# ------------------------------------------
dfinal <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_matrix, label = y_vector)
final_xgb <- xgb.train(params = list(objective = "binary:logistic"), 
                       data = dfinal, 
                       nrounds = 50, 
                       verbose = 0)

cat("--- Processing Native XGBoost Feature Importance Arrays ---\n")
# FIXED: Using xgb.importance avoids all environment package discovery errors completely
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(feature_names = feature_cols, model = final_xgb)
print(importance_matrix)

# ------------------------------------------
# 6. MACRO POLICY BUDGET SHOCK EXPERIMENTS
# ------------------------------------------
apply_funding_cut_scenarios <- function(base_dataframe, pre_process_model, final_classifier) {
  
  scenarios <- list(
    "Scenario 0: Baseline Performance"                   = c(spend = 1.00, mdr = 1.00),
    "Scenario 1: USAID Termination"                     = c(spend = 0.85, mdr = 1.05),
    "Scenario 2: USAID Term + US Red. Global Fund"      = c(spend = 0.75, mdr = 1.10),
    "Scenario 3: USAID Term + US Term. Global Fund"     = c(spend = 0.65, mdr = 1.15),
    "Scenario 4: USAID Term + Reduced Global Fund"      = c(spend = 0.55, mdr = 1.25),
    "Scenario 5: USAID Term + Major Donor Cut (1%+)"    = c(spend = 0.45, mdr = 1.35),
    "Scenario 6: Complete External Funding Elimination" = c(spend = 0.20, mdr = 1.60)
  )
  
  cat("\n--- Simulating Budget Shock Impacts on Household Catastrophic Risk Rates ---\n")
  
  for(name in names(scenarios)) {
    simulated_df <- base_dataframe
    shifts <- scenarios[[name]]
    
    simulated_df$health_spending_per_capita <- simulated_df$health_spending_per_capita * shifts["spend"]
    simulated_df$mdr_tb_incidence           <- simulated_df$mdr_tb_incidence * shifts["mdr"]
    
    for (col in skewed_cols) {
      simulated_df[[col]] <- log1p(simulated_df[[col]])
    }
    
    sim_scaled <- predict(pre_process_model, simulated_df[, feature_cols])
    predictions <- predict(final_classifier, as.matrix(sim_scaled))
    predicted_risk_share <- mean(ifelse(predictions > 0.5, 1, 0)) * 100
    
    cat(sprintf("%-50s -> System Projected High-Risk Share: %.2f%%\n", name, predicted_risk_share))
  }
}

apply_funding_cut_scenarios(df_filtered, scaler_pipeline, final_xgb)
```
